model_boundary: Synthetic loopback provider; actual packaged Electron Main/preload, HTTP over private local channel, shared Host/Runtime/ledger, real fixture patch and test processes. No provider-quality or external-user claims.
assertions: Desktop Main and private typed client share model configuration and one Runtime owner
Desktop and loopback Web gateway observe the same settings revision; stale CAS rejected
Fixed settings/status/skills/extensions/MCP/LSP/usage/telemetry routes reach the shared Host
Actual Desktop keyboard navigation/palette/settings controls and DOM composition Enter/newline semantics are verified
Actual packaged CLI shares owner/settings/model and rejects command-line credentials without printing values
Desktop composer stages the actual fixture image and Enter starts an executable task through fixed transport
Current public activity stays collapsed until the user opens actual operation history, then closes again
Three actual SSE feeds preserve independent cursors; public model/operation events forwarded, unsubscribe does not cancel Run
Exact approval command retry does not double-write; actual patch file, success receipt and 2/2 test-log Artifact agree
Test output is absent before an actual test and opens the same real Artifact content through the visible Desktop control
Attachment upload and relation-scoped read preserve exact bytes/media/hash across preload/private transport
Replay authority is opaque in renderer and read-only writes are rejected until explicit exit
Default rollback policy disables the UI action and records actual same-Action refusal without changing the file hash
Explicit isolated Host policy restart enables real UI force confirmation; durable same-Action rollback and external file hash restore agree
CLI queued holder cancellation removes only queued work, preserving the active Run and model dispatch
Closing Electron leaves the same owner and Run active; a new Desktop reconnects to that Run and receives completion
Explicit CLI cancellation exits zero only for canonical cancelled; task read remains exit 1 and next model dispatch is prevented
Actual CLI resource commands share PTY/preview/schedule receipts; isolated native preview has no Node/app bridge and closing view preserves service
Configured external editor executes one confined native-selected file with fixed argv
Native-selected migration exposes only metadata/source IDs, preserves source, backs up and rebinds Desktop to the new owner
Explicit Host stop yields actual offline readiness; native start reconnects the same profile without auto-restarting
